Single correlation with r, p value and optionally a Bayes factor

Source: R/singlecor.R
singlecor.Rd

Correlates two columns of a data frame, and returns Pearson's r with its p value, and Kendall's tau as a rank based alternative. Optionally, it adds a Bayes factor (using the BayesFactor package).

Usage

singlecor(data, x, y, bayes_factor = F)

Arguments

data

A data frame with the two columns to correlate.

x

Name of the first column.

y

Name of the second column.

bayes_factor

Calculate a Bayes factor? Needs the BayesFactor package.

Value

A list with r, p (both rounded to 3 places), bf (the Bayes factor for the correlation, rounded down to a whole number, or 0 if not requested) and k.tau (Kendall's tau).

See also

plotscat(), exclorr()

Examples

singlecor(mtcars, "mpg", "hp")
#> Warning: cannot compute exact p-value with ties
#> $r
#>    cor 
#> -0.776 
#> 
#> $p
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $bf
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $k.tau
#>    tau 
#> -0.743 
#>
